description: This file contains integration tests for accounting scenarios within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes several test cases verifying accounting flows for loans, savings, fixed deposits, and recurring deposits, with focus on accrual and periodic accounting rules. The tests involve creating products, applying for accounts, approving, activating, posting interest, and verifying journal entries and account balances. It utilizes REST APIs, JUnit assertions, and logs for validation.
